statement.p: Consider the partial derivatives f_{x}(x,y) = 5x^{4}y^{6}-15x^{2}y, f_{y}(x,y) = 6x^{5}y^{5}-5x^{3}. Is there a function f which has these partial derivatives?

p.em: (Enter none if there is no such function.)

static.solution: f_{x}(x,y) = 5x^{4}y^{6}-15x^{2}y, we could have f(x,y) = x^{5}y^{6}-5x^{3}y. In that case, f_{y}(x,y)=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x^{5}y^{6}-5x^{3}y) = 6x^{5}y^{5}-5x^{3}. Thus, this is a function that has the given partial derivatives. More generally, we could have f(x,y) = x^{5}y^{6}-5x^{3}y + C, where C is any constant.
